displayIdentity.body: Ancestry yields to danger, labor, weakness, and escape. Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I. I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
displayIdentity.title: Ancestry yields to danger, labor, weakness, and escape
